scripts.install-db: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='./lib/dictionary.db';if(!fs.existsSync(p)||fs.statSync(p).size<10000000){fs.mkdirSync('./lib',{recursive:true});require('child_process').execSync('curl --fail -L -o ./lib/dictionary.db https://github.com/minhqnd/dictionary/releases/latest/download/dictionary.db',{stdio:'inherit'});}else{console.log('Valid DB exists (' + Math.round(fs.statSync(p).size/1024/1024) + 'MB), skipping download');}"
